say:1:1030302201:0.text: As you can see, all the guards have lost their jobs.
say:1:1030302201:0.source_cn: 正如你看到的，守卫们都丢了工作。
say:1:1030302201:0.male: As you can see, all the guards have lost their jobs.

say:2:1030302202:0.text: What I didn't expect was how fast they all found a new one. But what about me? It doesn't seem fair...
say:2:1030302202:0.source_cn: 没想到的是大家好像很快找到了新的，而我呢？这太不公平了……

say:3:1030302203:0.female: Miss, I heard you were friends with Lady Vala. I know we haven't known each other long, but we're acquaintances now.

say:4:1030302204:0.text: Would you mind putting in a good word for me with Lady Vala? You saw how capable I am!
say:4:1030302204:0.source_cn: 你能向维拉夫人推荐下我吗？我的工作能力你也看到了！
